scope: Theorem3 and its F.1-based actual skewed independent-coordinate construction, including exact intrinsic Gaussian width normalization
headline_status: proved actual constructive existential theorem; freshsources and21stricttransitiveaudits passed; independentreviewpending
representation_notes: The probability space is explicitly the finite product space of n row-vectors, and its measure is the actual product of the displayed coordinate two-point law.

The general existential endpoint asserts finite-row covariance/envelope-attainment properties whenever n>=1 and p_n>=1. From p_n→infinity these hold eventually without any extra input. The positive-dimension endpoint gives those properties for every positive sample size under the usual positive-dimension convention.
The actual Gaussian width is the standard Gaussian infinity-norm integral; a pointwise theorem identifies its rate with the Gaussian covariance-factor mean forI.
An EReal liminf represents the usual extended lower limit. This avoids a hidden boundedness assumption on the full rectangle-distance/rate ratio.

passages.obligation: For any p_n→infinity and B_n≥2 with only the actual intrinsic rate tending tozero, construct genuine iid raw observations with independent coordinates, covarianceI, attained raw envelope, and exact liminf at least1/(4e).
